messages:
Maya: PRD + RFC up for API surface changes. TL;DR: unify chat/completions streaming + non-streaming consistency, add embeddings batch-by-id, and formalize rerank response (scores + explanation tokens). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/78 please skim acceptance criteria and edge cases. Need sign-off from eng/runtime + product before Thurs.

Ben: Quick Q: rerank output shape — should we return per-candidate `score` (float) and `metadata` object, or an array of tuples? I'd prefer explicit objects for future fields. Also, how do we handle ties? See my PR comment: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/78#discussion_r4321

Alex: Latency note: if we add per-token explanations on rerank, we must not break our 95th percentile SLO for chat (median under 120ms). Suggest optional field `explain=true` that returns `explanation` only when requested; also include `cost_estimate` in response to help product calculate billing projection.

Sara: Acceptance tests I propose:
- smoke: single chat -> deterministic score shape
- bulk embeddings: 1000 ids -> batching <= configured 256
- rerank: ties -> stable sort by original index
I'll add a checklist to the PR with test vectors.

Maya: Good. Edge cases to call out in the spec: empty candidate list (client compatibility decision needed), incompatible model variants (fallback policy and explicit error), and partially quantized model serving (small numeric diffs). I put suggested wording in the PR description.

Ben: On empty candidate list: existing clients expect HTTP 200 with `candidates: []` rather than 400. Breaking that will be annoying. Recommend 200 + `scores: []`.

Alex: Agree with Ben — avoid breaking clients. Add acceptance criteria: request with `candidates: []` returns 200 and empty `scores` array. Also: streaming chat must not emit `explanations` mid-stream; only after stream completion.

Sara: Also add explicit contract for streaming vs non-streaming chat: streaming responses SHOULD avoid adding rerank/explanation fields until stream end. Add smoke for partial-stream fallback (client opens stream then cancels).

Maya: Rollout notes: canary on Dedicated eu-west-1 for 48h, metrics to monitor: rerank latency p95, token-cost delta vs baseline, and error rate >0.5%. Rollback plan: revert model-variant mapping and re-enable previous endpoint routing.

Dmitri-bot: Deploy-bot: canary created -> canary-1800456789 on eu-west-1, 5% traffic.

Ben: Left a comment on line 42 re: wording around `metadata` field. I'll follow up with a small RFC on `explain` schema to avoid spec creep.

Alex: One more edge case: embeddings API should reject mixed-dimension vectors in the same batch (e.g., T=512 and T=1536). Recommend returning 400 with clear error: `mixed_vector_dimensions`. Add to validation section.

Sara: Adding those to tests. Also adding a sample request/response to the PR for implementers:

```
{
  "query": "How to optimize latency?",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "..."},
    {"id": "c2", "text": "..."}
  ],
  "explain": true
}
```

and response example:

```
{
  "scores": [{"id":"c1","score":0.92},{"id":"c2","score":0.87}],
  "explanations": [{"id":"c1","tokens":["opt","i","mize"], "cost":0.02}]
}
```

Maya: Thanks everyone. Please leave a +1 in thread if you can review acceptance criteria by EOD. @Ben @Alex @Sara

Ben: :thumbsup: I'll +1 after small wording fixes.

Alex: +1 pending perf run results.

Sara: +1 — added tests and checklist, will merge draft tomorrow.
